summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (IPNS Signature-Verify Coverage) of the CipherBox project end-to-end, then run the full ship pipeline: verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E → CodeRabbit CLI review → conventional-commit reword → PR creation → review resolution.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans, 2 waves), executed, verified (7/7 must-haves, all D-01..D-13 decisions confirmed in code), and driven through the ship pipeline through CodeRabbit CLI review with all 5 findings queued for application; SDK E2E passed 89/89, security audit 19/19 threats closed, Nyquist validation compliant. PR not yet opened — reword + push + PR creation pending the CodeRabbit fix commits.

repo: Phase 58 is the last phase of milestone v1.1-hardening; STATE.md reads 'Milestone complete' after it closes.

TEST_LOGIN_SECRET in apps/api/.env is 'e2e-test-secret-ci-only', not the SDK E2E default 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production'; a mismatch causes silent 401→all-tests-skipped, not a suite failure.
Vitest 3 does not auto-load tests/sdk-e2e/.env — SDK_E2E_SECRET must be passed explicitly on the CLI.
crates/crypto cannot dev-depend on api-client/core, so cross-language verify vectors live in crates/fuse/tests/, not crates/crypto/tests/.
gh pr edit fails on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL); PR body must be patched via 'env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file'.
After gh pr create, github-actions[bot] pushes a chore(release) commit to the branch — git fetch + rebase required before any subsequent push.
markdownlint runs on commit but excludes .planning/ — no need to lint files there.
commitlint + lint-pr-title CI gates reject parentheses in commit subjects; e.g. 'feat(58-04): ... (7 cases)' is non-compliant.
git rebase -i is unavailable in this environment; commit rewords require git filter-branch --msg-filter.
The commit helper reports commit_failed as a known false negative; always verify with 'git log --oneline -1' rather than retrying.
5 REQ-IDs (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08) are missing from the REQUIREMENTS.md traceability table — pre-existing hygiene, unrelated to HARD-09.
apps/desktop/src-tauri/ (prepopulate.rs, vault.rs) still has 6 unverified resolve_ipns call sites; explicitly deferred from Phase 58 scope (D-01..D-09 scoped to web/api/fuse paths).
CodeRabbit bundles findings in both the PR review body and inline review threads; /resolve-pr-reviews must handle both sources.

code.finding: Missing explicit existence check on cborFields['Sequence'] before BigInt coercion — should throw a clear binding-mismatch error if the field is absent rather than coercing undefined.

btoa(String.fromCharCode(...cbor)) used for base64 encoding CBOR bytes; CodeRabbit flagged it as potentially corrupting bytes >127 (though Latin-1 btoa handles 0-255). Should use Buffer.from(cbor).toString('base64') for clarity and to silence the linter.
Missing unit tests for two edge cases: u64 sequence overflow and invalid-UTF-8 Value rejection in the CBOR decoder.

New resolve_ipns_verified chokepoint routes all 9 FUSE resolve sites through CBOR cid/sequence verification; folder-key descent path kept hard fail-closed while other paths use scoped fail-closed posture (per D-01..D-08).

D-09 gate in upsertFolderIpns uses idempotent TEE re-sign path (no DB sequence increment, but latestCid still updated) for non-CAS embedded-sequence validation; line 245 expectedSequenceNumber guard retained as the CAS 409 conflict check.

workflow: Sequential execution on the feature branch is safer than parallel worktrees for multi-crate crypto phases — avoids cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees.
SDK E2E silent skip on secret mismatch is easy to misclassify as 'infra-limited'; always confirm the suite actually ran by checking the test count, not just exit code.
One executor can complete multiple plans in a single run when dispatched for the first — harmless if dependency ordering is already satisfied.
API socket close mid-execution leaves partial uncommitted work; a continuation agent scoped to 'validate-and-commit Task N, finish Tasks M+' is the clean recovery pattern.

Running the CodeRabbit CLI review (--agent --base main --type committed) before opening the PR catches issues the planner and plan-checker miss, especially test-quality gaps; expect a re-review of fix commits after the PR opens.

For a security hardening phase, deferring all simplify findings to a todo (rather than churning audited code pre-ship) is the right operating rule — the marginal gain is not worth the re-verification cost.
Parallel subagents for security audit + simplify review is safe since both are read-only analysis; SDK E2E (write-infra) should run separately to avoid API process conflicts.

friction: 58-01 executor crashed mid-task due to an API socket close after committing 3 of 5 tasks, requiring a manual-assess + continuation-agent recovery cycle.

SDK E2E was silently skipped by the 58-02 executor (labeled 'infra-limited') due to a TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch — the actual infra was up; the misclassification required a separate SDK E2E gate agent to clear.
The executor dispatched for 58-02 also executed 58-03 in the same run without being asked, compressing wave 2 unexpectedly (benign but obscures the wave boundary).
gh pr edit is blocked by Projects-classic GraphQL on this repo, requiring a non-obvious gh api -X PATCH workaround for PR body updates.
git push and git fetch are sandboxed and require the sandbox to be disabled — easy to forget and causes silent failures.
The commit_failed false negative from the commit helper is a recurring source of unnecessary re-verification.
